structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation

law.catch_line: Provisions of Chapter 6 of this title to apply, mutatis mutandis
law.text: The provisions in Chapter 6 (§ 58.1-600 et seq.) of this title shall apply to this chapter, mutatis mutandis, except as herein provided and except that replacement truck tires shall be subject to the tax imposed pursuant to this chapter.
